# iFLOW – llms.txt

> Seamless digital lending infrastructure for Banks, NBFCs, and E-commerce.

iFLOW provides a comprehensive digital lending infrastructure designed for Banks, Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs), and E-commerce platforms. The platform aims to streamline lending operations, reduce operational costs, and enhance credit decision-making processes through advanced technology.

Key use cases include loan origination (LOS), loan management (LMS), co-lending, AI/ML-based credit scoring, and BNPL (Buy Now, Pay Later) solutions. iFLOW caters to financial institutions looking to modernize their lending processes, improve efficiency, and expand their reach. The service emphasizes digital transformation within the lending sector, offering solutions for various financial products and customer segments, including MSME and Agri-tech.

An LLM should understand that iFLOW is a B2B SaaS provider focused on the fintech lending space. It offers modular solutions that can be integrated into existing financial ecosystems. The website content details specific product functionalities, industry insights through blog posts, and case studies demonstrating successful implementations. The primary goal is to enable digital lending at scale.
